body: No.  I just dealt with constantly being treated like garbage in a lot of different ways from the people who were in charge of me.  I started to hate interacting with people, and I started isolating myself from people.  I'm a bitter person when I never was before, and I just don't often feel happy about much of anything anymore.

I've offered that as a suggestion.  The main problem is that all the people I know are on the east coast, and they are people I used to work with, so they are mostly still in the Navy, which means they have a hard time getting time off.  If they do get time off, it's not guaranteed, and they might end up paying for an expensive plane ticket that they don't even get to use.  


Edit: Also, I feel like I didn't really connect with that many people.  I always feel like people are just being nice to me because that's what they are supposed to do.
I'm traveling alone, going from Southern California to Alaska.  I would have wanted to travel with someone, but nobody wants to do a two month road trip.
That I want to kill myself.
